data.title: CORRECTION FROM SOURCE: Nixxy Announces 1-for-20 Reverse Stock Split
data.description:
CUSIP Number Corrected

NEW YORK CITY, NY / ACCESS Newswire / November 18, 2026 / Nixxy, Inc. today announced that it will conduct a reverse stock split of its outstanding shares of common stock at a ratio of 1-for-20. The reverse stock split will become effective at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on November 20, 2026. The Company's common stock will begin trading on a post-split basis at the market open on November 20, 2026, under the Company's existing trading symbol "NIXX", with the new CUSIP number, 75630B501. The reverse stock split is part of the Company's plan to regain compliance with the minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share required to maintain continued listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market, among other benefits.

The reverse stock split was approved by the Company's board of directors on October 20, 2026, pursuant to Section 78.207 of the Nevada Revised Statutes, and does not require stockholder approval.

The reverse stock split reduces the number of shares of the Company's outstanding common stock from approximately 29.5 million shares to approximately 1.5 million shares, subject to adjustment for the rounding up of fractional shares. As a result of the reverse stock split, proportionate adjustments will be made to the number of shares of the Company's common stock underlying the Company's outstanding equity awards and warrants and the number of shares issuable under the Company's equity incentive plans and other existing agreements, as well as the exercise or conversion price, as applicable. In connection with the reverse stock split, the number of authorized shares of the Company's common stock will be correspondingly reduced from 200,000,000 shares to 10,000,000 shares. There will be no change to the par value per share of the Company's common stock.

Information for NIXX Stockholders

As a result of the reverse stock split, every twenty pre-split shares of common stock outstanding will become one share of common stock. The Company's transfer agent, Nevada Agency and Transfer Company, will serve as the exchange agent for the reverse stock split.

Registered stockholders holding pre-split shares of the Company's common stock electronically in book-entry form are not required to take any action to receive post-split shares. Those stockholders who hold their shares in brokerage accounts or in "street name" will have their positions automatically adjusted to reflect the reverse stock split, subject to each broker's particular processes, and will not be required to take any action in connection with the reverse stock split. Stockholders holding shares of the Company's common stock in certificate form will have their holdings of the Company's common stock automatically adjusted to reflect the reverse stock split.

No fractional shares will be issued in connection with the reverse stock split. Stockholders who otherwise would be entitled to receive a fractional share will instead have such fractional share rounded up to the next whole share.

About Nixxy, Inc.

Nixxy, Inc. is pursuing a strategy to develop and invest in critical infrastructure supporting the accelerating demand for artificial intelligence, digital infrastructure, and advanced energy systems. Through disciplined capital allocation and strategic partnerships, the Company seeks to originate, develop, finance, operate, and optimize infrastructure assets positioned to support long-term growth across the AI economy.

data.title: Fed Minutes Confirm Most Officials Expect Further Rate Hikes
data.description:
WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - While the Federal Reserve decided to leave interest rates following its October meeting, the minutes of the meeting, released on Wednesday, revealed that the central bank is likely to resume raising rates in the near future.

The Fed minutes said 'almost all participants' judged that further action to raise rates would likely be appropriate in order to ensure a timely return of inflation to the 2 percent objective.

'A couple of participants noted that an increase of more than 25 basis points could warrant consideration at the next meeting if incoming inflation data were unfavorable,' the Fed said.

The central bank also said a few participants observed that inflation could prove more persistent than anticipated, necessitating a shift to a more restrictive policy stance.

Following the October meeting, the Fed announced its widely expected decision to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 3.75 to 4 percent.

The decision to leave rates unchanged was not unanimous, however, as Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack preferred raising rates by another quarter point following the 25-basis point increase in September.

Nonetheless, most participants expressed support for leaving rates unchanged, with many pointing to the benefits in accumulating additional information.

'These participants cited the need to assess the durability of AI-related investment demand, the evolution of financing conditions, the transmission of the September rate increase to the economy, or geopolitical development,' the Fed said.

The Fed said a couple of participants noted that a gradual approach to policy firming would give businesses and households time to adjust to higher interest rates.

The central bank noted a few participates who supported leaving rates unchanged viewed the decision as a 'close call.'

Meanwhile, the Fed said the participants that favored raising rates by a quarter point emphasized that inflation had remained too high and that they saw few signs of it abating.

'They judged that the current policy stance was not sufficiently restrictive, and a few of them warned that further delay risked allowing high inflation to become entrenched or necessitating a larger and more disruptive tightening later,' the Fed added.

The Fed's next monetary policy meeting is scheduled for December 8-9, with CME Group's FedWatch Tool currently indicating a 94.7 percent chance of a quarter point rate hike.

data.title: Nissan uses Mexico to prep for potential China challenge in US
data.description:
Key points:
  • Nissan exec sees battle vs Chinese in Mexico as 'experiment' for US
  • Nissan cutting costs through simpler engineering, automation
  • The Japanese automaker plans model blitz to revive US business

By Mike Colias

As head of Nissan’s US business, Christian Meunier doesn’t need to imagine what might happen if fast-rising Chinese car brands one day crack the American market. He’s already been confronting that battle south of the border, in Mexico.

Meunier, chairman of Nissan Americas, oversees the Japanese automaker's operations across the Western Hemisphere. He has been fending off an influx of Chinese brands in Mexico, where Nissan has been the top-selling car company for many years.

Meunier said his team is working on reducing costs to be able to match Chinese competitors by shortening the vehicle-development process, reducing supply chain costs and other tactics.

“Our cost base today in [the US] is not competitive. It's not strong enough,” Meunier said at a conference in Detroit hosted by MEMA, The Vehicle Suppliers Association.

REVIVING US BUSINESS A FOCUS

Exports of Chinese cars have surged over the past three years, sending global automakers scrambling to compete with vehicles that often are priced 30% cheaper than domestic models.

For now, Meunier’s main focus is revitalizing the Nissan brand in the US, where the automaker’s market share sank by one-third over a decade through last year. It has been rebounding but, at around 6%, remains well below its peak.

Nissan is planning a blitz of new models to bring back customers. Up first is a hybrid version of its top seller, the Rogue compact SUV, which began arriving at showrooms in recent weeks.

Later in the decade, Nissan plans to roll out several rugged SUVs built on ​a truck-like frame, including the reintroduction of the Xterra, which was sold in ​the US from ⁠the 1990s to the mid-2010s.

For now, Meunier isn't worried about Chinese car brands in the US, where a combination of tariffs and a ban on Chinese software has effectively blocked their entry. But he figures they could show up within the next five or 10 years.

“We need to be ready,” he said at a media briefing Tuesday.

MEXICO AN 'EXPERIMENT' TO PREP FOR CHINESE RIVALS IN US

There is more urgency in Mexico, where Chinese brands have been importing cars to grab a 10% market share in a short period, according to research firm AutoForecast Solutions. A tariff that took effect early this year limits the Chinese companies' ability to undercut the market on price.

Meunier said Nissan has “a two-year window” before the Chinese companies begin making cars in Mexico, avoiding levies. He wants to get Nissan’s costs down during that period through automation and simpler engineering.

He sees that effort in Mexico as a test run for eventually competing against Chinese rivals in the US market.

“Mexico is going to be a really good ground for us to experiment and to learn” how to match the Chinese on cost, he said.

data.title: Epsium Enterprise Limited Reports Unaudited Financial Results for the Six Months Ended June 30, 2026
data.description:
MACAU, Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Epsium Enterprise Limited (Nasdaq: EPSM) ("Epsium" or the "Company"), an importer and wholesale distributor of premium alcoholic beverages in Macau, today announced its unaudited financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026.

Revenue for the first half of 2026 decreased to $1.47 million from $3.04 million in the prior-year period amid continued weakness in demand and wholesale pricing for premium Chinese liquor in Macau. Gross profit declined to $0.18 million from $0.50 million. Operating loss increased to $0.75 million from $0.69 million, as lower general and administrative expenses only partially offset the decline in gross profit, while net loss narrowed to $0.67 million from $0.70 million, reflecting higher other income.

First Half 2026 Financial Highlights

  • Revenue decreased 51.8% to $1,466,303 from $3,042,988.
  • Gross profit was $175,353, compared with $495,310; gross margin was 11.96%, compared with 16.28%.
  • General and administrative expenses decreased 22.3% to $918,861 from $1,183,240.
  • Operating loss was $748,194, compared with $691,746. Net loss narrowed 4.5% to $667,598 from $699,106. Net loss attributable to Epsium Enterprise Limited was $667,026, compared with $700,372. Basic and diluted loss per share was $(0.05) for each of Class A and Class B ordinary shares in 2026; the 2025 reported loss per Class A ordinary share was $(0.05).
  • Product mix: fine wine accounted for approximately 41% of revenue, compared with approximately 12%; Chinese liquor accounted for approximately 40%, compared with approximately 79%.
  • Balance sheet: as of June 30, 2026, cash was $612,761, inventories, net were $8,255,912 and working capital was $10,579,060, with no bank borrowings.

Management Commentary

"The first half of 2026 remained challenging for premium Chinese liquor in Macau, with continued pressure on both demand and wholesale prices," said Mr. Son I Tam, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Epsium. "We broadened our portfolio toward fine wine and reduced general and administrative costs by more than 20%. Our priorities include converting inventory into cash and exploring new sales channels through Starlight Years."

First Half 2026 Results

Revenue. Sales to gaming and hotel groups decreased approximately 46% to $1,080,050, and sales to the local market decreased approximately 63% to $386,253, as demand for and wholesale prices of premium Chinese liquor remained weak. Sales of Moutai fell to approximately 35% of revenue from approximately 78%.

Gross margin. The decline in gross margin reflected the higher proportion of lower-margin fine wine and continued price competition. Gross margin on sales to gaming and hotel groups narrowed to approximately 15.6% from approximately 22.8%, and local-market sales were realized at approximately breakeven.

Expenses and other income. The decrease in general and administrative expenses reflected lower professional and consultancy fees; the prior-year period included IPO-related costs. Net other income of $82,713 consisted principally of a forgiveness of payable of approximately $78,700 from a supplier on Chinese liquor purchased in a prior period.

Liquidity and Going Concern

Net cash used in operating activities was $1,362,134 for the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with $1,927,422 in the prior-year period. As of June 30, 2026, cash was $612,761, compared with $1,978,728 as of December 31, 2025. Net inventories were $8,255,912, representing approximately 68% of total assets, and working capital was $10,579,060. Although the Company had no bank borrowings, a substantial portion of its current assets consisted of inventories.

The Company does not expect its operations to generate net positive cash flows over the next twelve months. Management has prepared a twelve-month cash flow forecast, based on current trading levels and assuming no new borrowings or equity issuance. Taking into account cash on hand, expected customer collections and management's plans to realize additional cash from existing inventory, management believes substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern has been alleviated. The amount and timing of cash realized from inventory are inherently uncertain. If management's plans do not generate the expected cash, the Company would seek to reduce operating expenditures and inventory purchases and sell inventory through existing channels; there can be no assurance these measures would be sufficient. Investors should review the going-concern discussion, including management's plans, in the Company's Form 6-K.

Recent Developments

Starlight Years Entertainment Limited, 60% owned by the Company's subsidiary Media Icon Limited, completed its commercial registration in Macau during the first half of 2026. The Company intends to use Starlight Years to pursue entertainment and event-promotion opportunities, including beverage sales at event venues.

About Epsium Enterprise Limited

Through its Macau operating entity, Companhia de Comércio Luz Limitada ("Luz"), a limited liability company established under the laws of Macau in 2010, Epsium is engaged in the import and wholesale distribution of primarily alcoholic beverages in Macau. The Company's portfolio includes Chinese liquor, French cognac, Scotch whisky, fine wine, Champagne and other beverage alcohol, sold through gaming and hotel groups, supermarkets, restaurants, bars and other channels across Macau. For more information, please visit epsium.co/investor-relations.

Forward-Looking Statements

This press release contains forward-looking statements. These statements are based on the Company's current expectations and assumptions and involve known and unknown risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied in such statements. Forward-looking statements can be identified by words such as "believes," "expects," "anticipates," "estimates," "intends," "plans," "will," "would," "should," "could," "may," or similar expressions. These statements include, but are not limited to, statements regarding the Company's business strategy, product mix, inventory monetization, management's plans to realize cash from inventory, liquidity and the Company's ability to continue as a going concern, new sales channels and growth initiatives. Actual results may differ materially due to a number of factors, including changes in market conditions in Macau, visitor arrivals and spending, consumer demand, pricing and competition, supply conditions, the Company's ability to sell its inventories, the amount and timing of cash realized from inventory, regulatory developments, and other risks described in the "Risk Factors" section of the Company's Annual Report on Form 20-F filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on April 29, 2026. data.title: Lowe's 3Q Sales Rise, as Professional Customers Drive Growth — Update
data.description:
By Connor Hart

Lowe's reported higher sales in the recent quarter, largely driven by growth in its business selling to professional customers.

Profit climbed as well, thanks to a large tariff refund the home-improvement retailer said it plans to reinvest in the business. Still, Lowe's maintained its earnings outlook for the year and said higher costs are weighing on margins.

Shares fell premarket but pared their losses and were roughly flat in afternoon trading.

Chief Executive Marvin Ellison on Wednesday said professional customers are responding well to enhancements Lowe's has made to its fulfillment network. At the same time, loyalty offerings are helping the company to deepen customer relationships and capture more spend.

Third-quarter net sales climbed 9.3% to $22.76 billion, just ahead of Wall Street estimates for $22.39 billion. Growth across Lowe's professional business--as well as its home-services unit and online sales channels--helped offset softer trends across the company's do-it-yourself business.

There are some green shoots, though. For instance, Lowe's logged its strongest quarter of appliance sales in five years, Ellison said on a call with analysts.

"That says a lot when you think about the pressure that the DIY consumer is under," he added.

Lowe's results echo those of rival Home Depot, which also reported higher sales and profit in the latest quarter, helped by strength among professional contractors despite continued weakness in the broader home-improvement market.

Lowe's said comparable sales, which account for store openings and closings, climbed 1.8% for the three months ended Oct. 30, ahead of analyst views for a 0.1% gain. Higher average tickets, which in part reflected inflation in commodity-driven categories such as lumber and electrical cable, offset a decline in comparable transactions, Chief Financial Officer Brandon Sink said.

For the year, Lowe's now expects same-store sales to tick up 0.5%, whereas they were previously expected to be flat.

Profit climbed to $1.67 billion, from $1.62 billion a year earlier. Adjusted earnings came in at $3.10 a share, including a 34-cent benefit tied to tariff refunds. Analysts were looking for adjusted earnings of $2.88 a share.

Excluding the tariff refund, Lowe's said its bottom line was pressured by recent acquisitions, as well as elevated fuel and transportation costs. Productivity initiatives spanning merchandising, stores, supply chain and corporate functions are helping to offset that pressure, Sink said.

Lowe's reinvested about a third of its $250 million tariff refund back into the business during the third quarter, and the company expects to reinvest the remainder during the fourth.

"Our intention is to reinvest our tariff refunds in ways that strengthen our customer value proposition by putting these dollars to work to enhance the customer experience, strengthen our competitive position, and bring value to our customers," Ellison said.

For the year, Lowe's continues to expect earnings of about $11.25 a share, or about $12.25 a share on an adjusted basis.

Write to Connor Hart at connor.hart@wsj.com

data.title: Comstock Resources cut to Sell equivalent, CNX Resources raised at Morgan Stanley
data.description:
Comstock Resources fell 2.4% in Wednesay's trading as Morgan Stanley downgraded the oil and gas company to Underweight from Equal Weight with a $13 price target, saying the shares currently trade ~20% above the bank's net asset value at strip pricing.

Comstock announced in September a $1.65B strategic partnership with Azerbaijan's SOCAR in exchange for non-operating working interests in its legacy and Western Haynesville assets; concurrently, Comstock majority owner Jerry Jones entered into a joint venture to fund the drilling and completion costs of some legacy and Western Haynesville wells in exchange for an ownership stake.

Morgan Stanley analyst Devin McDermott said while he views the transactions positively, as they improve Comstock's liquidity position, he still forecasts an outspend in 2027 at $3 Henry Hub.

The bank also upgraded CNX Resources to Equal Weight from Underweight with a $36 PT, saying the company is the most hedged gas E&P within its coverage, with nearly 80% of 2027 production protected, supporting relatively stable cash flow even at lower Henry Hub prices.

data.title: Tevogen Highlights Significant Liability Reduction and Continued Insider Control
data.description:
Key points:
  • Loss from operations declined 17% year over year for the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

WARREN, N.J., Nov. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tevogen Inc. (“Tevogen” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: TVGN), a healthcare company focused on combining biopharma, artificial intelligence, and healthcare services to improve the affordability and accessibility of life-saving medicines, today highlighted a significant reduction in liabilities, from $99.9 million for year ended 2023 as reported on Form 10-Q filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) on May 28, 2024, to $14.8 million for the period ended September 30, 2026 as reported on Form 10-Q filed November 16, 2026. Subsequent to September 30, 2026, the Company further eliminated $7.6 million in liabilities related to a loan obligation.

The Company maintains strong insider ownership with an increase from 83% on February 14, 2024, to 92% as of November 16, 2026.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, loss from operations decreased 17%, from $21.5 million in the same period of 2025 to $18.0 million. Additional information available in the Company’s 10-Q.

“Fiscal responsibility guides how we manage our obligations and make financing decisions,” said Ryan Saadi, MD, MPH, Founder and CEO of Tevogen. “Retaining majority control keeps decisions about our direction and growth in the hands of our team. This is central to our strategy as we pursue long-term shareholder value and our ambition to redefine the future of medicine.”

About Tevogen

Tevogen is a healthcare company focused on improving the affordability and accessibility of life-saving medicines. The Company brings together three complementary efforts: Tevogen Bio, its biotechnology initiative; Tevogen.AI, its artificial intelligence and technology initiative; and Tevogen Healthcare Services, its emerging healthcare services initiative.

Together, these efforts are designed to create a more integrated healthcare model in which science, technology, and operational efficiency work together to reduce the cost of medication and expand patient access.

data.title: ComEd Joins Better Business Bureau, Peoples Gas and North Shore Gas to Warn Customers: Holiday Distractions Can Open the Door to Utility Scams
data.description:
The holiday season brings shopping, gatherings, travel and plenty of distractions. It can also create an opening for utility scammers looking to take advantage of busy customers and pressure them into handing over money or personal information. This Utility Scam Awareness Day, ComEd, Peoples Gas, North Shore Gas and the Better Business Bureau (BBB) of Chicago and Northern Illinois urge families and businesses to stay alert for impostors who may call, text, email or show up at the door claiming to represent a utility. Scammers often create a false sense of urgency, including threats to immediately disconnect service, to get customers to act before they have time to question or verify the request.

The message from the BBB and northern Illinois utilities is simple: slow down and verify. ComEd will never demand immediate payment under threat of disconnection, and taking a moment to question a suspicious request can help customers protect their money and personal information.

“Scammers count on creating a sense of urgency so customers act before they have time to question what they’re being told,” said Tom Byrne, director of Security at ComEd. “Our message is simple: slow down. If someone is threatening immediate disconnection, demanding an unusual form of payment or asking for sensitive information, stop the conversation and verify the request directly with ComEd. Taking that extra moment can help protect your money and personal information.”

Utility scams often rely on urgency and fear. A scammer may pose as a utility employee, claim a customer’s account is past due and threaten to immediately disconnect service unless a payment is made. Others may seek personal or financial information, demand payment through prepaid cards, cryptocurrency, or third-party payment apps, or show up at a customer’s door pretending to be a utility worker.

“Scams are getting more sophisticated with new technologies. They are engineered to look and sound just like your trusted utility. Take a moment to think things through and verify contacts,” said Peter Muntaner, Manager of Contact and Support Centers and Claims — Peoples Gas and North Shore Gas. “If you don’t feel right about what the person is saying or if they’re pressuring you in any way, end the conversation. Hang up the phone, close the door, don’t respond to the email. Contacting your utility directly is a great way to confirm legitimacy.”

The BBB reminds customers and businesses to remain vigilant when someone claiming to represent a utility appears at their home or business and threatens to turn off service unless an immediate payment is made.

“Today's utility scammers are becoming increasingly sophisticated, using convincing caller IDs, official-looking messages and even personal account information to make their schemes appear legitimate,” said Steve Bernas, president and CEO of the Better Business Bureau of Chicago and Northern Illinois. “Consumers should understand that a familiar company name on their phone or a professional-looking message is no guarantee they're dealing with the real utility. Never let the appearance of legitimacy replace independent verification.”

Know the signs of a utility scam

The BBB and northern Illinois utility companies encourage customers to watch for common tactics, including:

  • Threats of immediate disconnection. A caller claims your account is overdue and says your electric service will be shut off unless you pay within a short period.

  • Demands for unusual payment methods. Scammers may demand payment through prepaid cash or gift cards, cryptocurrency or third-party payment apps.

  • Requests for sensitive information. Scammers may ask for Social Security numbers, driver’s license information, bank information or other personal details.

  • Door-to-door impostors. Someone posing as a utility employee may appear at a home or business asking for money or account information. Previous scam warnings have also cautioned that an impostor may attempt to lure a customer outside while another individual enters the property.

  • Digital scams. Customers should also be alert to suspicious contacts through texts, emails and online or social media channels as scammers expand beyond traditional phone and door-to-door schemes.

  • AI tactics. Scammers are increasingly using advanced artificial intelligence (AI) to generate highly convincing fake outage and past-due text message alerts. Stay alert and verify any unexpected requests before taking action.

  • Spoofing: Spoofed phone numbers make calls appear to come from a trusted source like ComEd or can be used to send “smishing” text messages. Don’t rely on caller ID or a familiar-looking number. If pressured for payment or personal information, stop and verify using an official phone number or website.

  • Pressure to act immediately. Threatening or aggressive tactics designed to prevent customers from pausing to verify a request are a major warning sign.

Slow Down and Verify

Customers should never provide Social Security, banking or other personal information to someone who unexpectedly contacts them claiming to represent a utility. If someone visits a home or business claiming to be a utility field representative, customers should ask to see company identification before allowing the person inside.

Customers who believe they have experienced fraud should end the interaction and contact local authorities, followed by their utility using a trusted contact number.

About ComEd

ComEd is a unit of Chicago-based Exelon Corporation (), a Fortune 200 company and one of the nation’s largest utility companies, serving more than 10.7 million electricity and natural gas customers. ComEd powers the lives of more than 4 million customers across northern Illinois, or 70 percent of the state's population. For more information visit ComEd.com, and connect with the company on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, and YouTube.

About Better Business Bureau of Chicago & Northern Illinois

BBB of Chicago and Northern Illinois is a nonprofit organization that holds businesses to a higher standard and connect consumers with businesses they can trust. We have served both local Chicago and Northern Illinois consumers and trustworthy businesses for over 95 years. We help protect consumers from fraudulent practices in the marketplace and provide an extensive free database for consumers to see business ratings and reviews for research before they buy.

About Peoples Gas

Peoples Gas, a subsidiary of WEC Energy Group (), is a regulated natural gas delivery company that serves more than 898,000 residential, commercial and industrial customers in the city of Chicago. Find more information about natural gas safety, energy efficiency and other energy-related topics at peoplesgasdelivery.com. Follow us on X, Facebook and Instagram @peoplegaschi.

North Shore Gas, a subsidiary of WEC Energy Group (), is a regulated natural gas delivery company that serves more than 166,000 residential, commercial and industrial customers in 54 communities within the northern suburbs of Chicago. Find more information about natural gas safety, energy efficiency and other energy-related topics at northshoregasdelivery.com. data.title: Elastic Makes High-Accuracy, Cost-Efficient Jina AI Models Available on Microsoft Foundry
data.description:
Elastic () today announced that jina-embeddings-v5-text and jina-embeddings-v5-omni models are now available in the Microsoft Foundry model catalog, deploying as a dedicated endpoint in the customer’s own Microsoft Azure environment. Developers building AI agents and search applications on Azure can run the models as dedicated endpoints in their own Azure accounts, bringing highly accurate semantic search and retrieval to their applications without the compute costs of larger models.

Jina AI by Elastic builds small, purpose-built models that rank at or near the top of industry benchmarks. Jina embeddings v5 for text bring high accuracy in a small footprint across more than 100 languages. The models serve as the backbone for the v5 embeddings omni models, which add multimodal support for images, audio, and video over the same languages. In standard benchmarks, Jina embeddings v5 omni models deliver frontier-class results across all four of these modalities. They outperform models up to 20x larger on image benchmarks (MIEB and ViDoRe), lead their size class on audio (MAEB), and compete with video grounding models several times their size (MMEB-v2).

The Jina embeddings v5 model family includes two types of models, each available in two parameter sizes:

  • Text models: jina-embeddings-v5-text-small and jina-embeddings-v5-text-nano are multilingual text embeddings for retrieval, matching, clustering and classification.
  • Omni models: jina-embeddings-v5-omni-small and jina-embeddings-v5-omni-nano add support for images, audio and video, all in one vector space, allowing unified cross-modal search with a single query.

“AI applications succeed or fail on retrieval, and the best embedding model is the one a team can run where its data already lives,” said Han Xiao, vice president of AI, Elastic. “Bringing Jina embeddings v5 to Microsoft Foundry means teams building on Microsoft Azure can add accurate multilingual, multimodal retrieval to their AI agents and search applications, running in their own Azure accounts, without the compute costs of larger models.”

"Customers need the flexibility to choose the right model for each workload,” said Uli Homann, corporate vice president and distinguished architect, Microsoft. “Adding Jina embeddings v5 to Microsoft Foundry broadens the choice of specialized models for multilingual and multimodal retrieval. These models deploy as dedicated endpoints in the customer's Microsoft Azure environment, helping teams build search and agent experiences within their established security and governance boundaries."

Availability

Jina embeddings v5 text and omni models are available now in the Microsoft Foundry model catalog as dedicated endpoints. Get started here.

About Elastic

Elastic () integrates its deep expertise in search technology with artificial intelligence to help everyone transform all of their data into answers, actions, and outcomes. Elasticsearch, which is the foundation for its search, observability, and security solutions, is used by thousands of companies, including more than 75% of the Fortune 100. Learn more at elastic.co.

Elastic and associated marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of elasticsearch B.V. and its subsidiaries. All other company and product names may be trademarks of their respective owners.

data.title: Copper Settles at Lowest Level Since April Amid AI Market Turmoil, Chinese Demand Concerns — 2nd Update
data.description:
By Giulia Petroni and Anthony Harrup

Copper prices tumbled Wednesday to their lowest level in seven months as a stronger U.S. dollar, growing concerns over Chinese industrial demand and a selloff in AI-related stocks overshadowed tightening supplies of the metal.

Three-month copper futures on the London Metal Exchange fell 4.6% to $12,471.00 a metric ton, the lowest settlement since April 7. Front month copper fell 5.3% in New York to $5.6595 a pound, also the lowest since April 7.

The selloff highlights a growing disconnect in the copper market. While inventories in China have fallen sharply and global mine production remains constrained, concerns over the health of the world's second-largest economy are weighing on demand expectations.

China's prolonged property downturn is a particular concern given copper's extensive use in construction, electrical wiring and infrastructure. Although investment in power networks, renewable energy and electric vehicles offers longer-term support, weakness in traditional industrial activity remains a near-term headwind, according to analysts.

Investors have also been unsettled by management turmoil at leading chip maker Nvidia and concerns over tighter regulatory oversight that could slow the expansion of AI infrastructure following the Democratic Party's sweep of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections.

"The recent selloff in artificial intelligence stocks has taken some of the shine off copper, which of course is the metal that actually wires the digital dream together," Price Futures Group senior market analyst Phil Flynn said in a note. "The key question is whether industrial demand actually weakens, or whether the market is simply repricing a crowded growth story."

The weakness in copper spilled across the metals complex, adding pressure on precious metals.

"A firmer dollar and expectations that interest rates may stay higher are weighing on gold and silver, while momentum selling is adding pressure," Flynn added.

Front month gold fell 3.2% in New York to $3,736.80 a troy ounce, its lowest settlement since Sept. 24, 2025. Silver fell 4.8% to $44.999 a troy ounce, also its lowest in almost 14 months.

Minutes of the Federal Reserve's October meeting supported expectations that the U.S. central bank will raise interest rates in December after a pause last month.

The Fed said almost all participants considered that it would be appropriate to raise rates further, and that a couple of participants said an increase of more than a quarter percentage point "could warrant consideration" at the next meeting if incoming inflation data were unfavorable.

Higher interest rates would increase borrowing costs for households and businesses, potentially weighing on housing, construction and infrastructure investment--all important sources of copper demand. A stronger dollar could add further pressure by making dollar-denominated commodities more expensive for buyers using other currencies.

data.title: Leopold Aschenbrenner plots 'Situational Awareness 2.0' comeback - report
data.description:
Leopold Aschenbrenner is plotting an reboot for his hedge fund Situational Awareness just four months after the AI-focused vehicle nearly collapsed under leveraged bets and required an emergency rescue from billionaire Ken Griffin's Citadel, according to a media report published Wednesday.

In recent weeks, the 25-year-old has discussed plans for "Situational Awareness 2.0" with prime brokers and investors, including a return to leveraged trading and raising new capital, the Financial Times reported, citing people with knowledge of the matter.

The move represents a reversal from July, when Aschenbrenner issued a mea culpa vowing he would no longer borrow money from lenders to amplify his bets. His success hinges on convincing Wall Street he can manage risk after assets plunged from more than $20B to needing an emergency rescue in a matter of days this past summer. The fund still manages more than $10B, mainly in private stakes, the FT reported.

Situational Awareness holds an approximately $5B stake in AI giant Anthropic —where Aschenbrenner's wife serves as chief of staff to CEO Dario Amodei—that is expected to appreciate markedly after the initial public offering.

Aschenbrenner has also discussed raising additional capital from outside investors in the new year, though plans have not been finalized, people involved in the talks said, the FT reported.

Aschenbrenner reportedly has been in discussions with Jefferies to set up a prime brokerage account, following an earlier rejection this year over concerns that the fund wasn't adequately hedged. Meanwhile, Situational Awareness is also partnering with the specialist brokerage Clear Street.

The San Francisco-based hedge fund during the summer had to strike an emergency deal with Citadel to offload most of its public equities at a discount in order to repay lenders like Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan Chase —both of which had provided financing despite Aschenbrenner's minimal trading background. JPMorgan later terminated its lending to the fund. Situational Awareness continues to oversee a modest public portfolio that includes positions in SharonAI and data center developer CleanSpark .

data.title: Canadian dollar hits 19-month low after hawkish Fed governor comments
data.description:
By Fergal Smith

The Canadian dollar weakened to a 19-month low against its US counterpart on Wednesday as recent strength in US economic data and hawkish comments from an influential Federal Reserve policymaker helped underpin the greenback.

The loonie was trading 0.2% lower at 1.4325 per US dollar, or 69.81 US cents, after touching its weakest intraday level since April 2025 at 1.4340.

  • "I think that the US dollar was looking a bit heavy until we had the stronger-than-expected jobs growth numbers and the hotter-than-expected inflation numbers," said Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets. "This has turned the dollar around broadly, not just against the Canadian dollar."

  • The US dollar added to recent gains against a basket of major currencies as Fed Governor Christopher Waller said the central bank needs to become more aggressive in its response to inflation that he fears is changing public psychology about prices.

  • "My work shows a stronger correlation between changes in the greenback and changes in the 2-year yields," Chandler said.

  • The US 2-year yield has moved about 21 basis points further above the Canadian equivalent since the start of the month to a gap of 148.5 basis points.

  • The Bank of Canada could also raise interest rates in December — investors see a roughly 60% chance of a hike. (0#CADIRPR)

  • The BoC's practice of issuing scenarios on inflation and growth keeps the central bank accountable and helps make monetary policy more effective, Deputy Governor Toni Gravelle said.

  • The price of oil, one of Canada's major exports, fell after US crude and fuel inventories data added to expectations of a supply surplus. US crude futures were trading 4.1% lower at $82.50 a barrel, which could ease concerns about the inflation outlook.

  • Canadian bond yields fell across a flatter curve, tracking moves in US Treasuries, with the 10-year (CA10YT=RR) down 2.5 basis points at 3.795%.
